summary: Implemented the first complete city-operations vertical slice: additive geo/review/audit schema, Annweiler pilot review backfill, server-only service-role DTO DAL behind requireAdmin, global all-city review queue, city/region/type/stage/search filters, content detail with source and field-level issues, audited correction/reject/publish RPC actions, strict double-layer event publication gate, navigation, loading/empty/error states, tests, build, and browser walkthrough.
evidence: Browser walkthrough: /city-operations and Annweiler Burgentagung detail
verification: npm run build: passed; both city-operations routes compiled
browser: authenticated global queue rendered three real Annweiler drafts
browser: Burgentagung rendered its 22:00 end but blocked publication because review metadata is absent
safety: Every privileged action calls requireAdmin before createAdminClient.
Only service_role may execute review transition and publish RPCs.
No UI action directly updates city_events.
Publish requires a fresh verified HTTPS source, verified event end, pass verdict, ready_for_human stage, expiry, and zero blocking issues in both TypeScript and SQL.
No invented two-hour event duration exists in the new migration.
The migration is additive and does not publish content when applied.
known_limits: Production migration application was explicitly outside T003. The live database migration history is also out of sync with local files, so a normal db push safely refused even in dry-run.
Until the migration is applied through a controlled single-migration path, the dashboard fails closed by synthesizing a blocking missing-review issue for every live draft.
The pre-existing community approval route that invents a two-hour duration remains outside this Worker file boundary and must be fixed by a later Judge-approved package.
scope_check: All product edits stayed within the exact T003 allowed_files list. Existing dirty translation and microsite work was preserved.
